protocol.equity_method: exact when remaining board runouts <=1500; otherwise 128 deterministic Monte Carlo runouts per unique hand/board/opponent-hole state; multiway pot shares use split-pot equity
protocol.leader_aware_stack_information: The leader-aware variant additionally receives all current tournament stack sizes; stacks are visible at a physical poker table but are not part of the canonical hero-only observation.
protocol.oracle_information: actual current hole cards of every non-folded opponent; no future board cards; folded hole cards are hidden from policy and treated as unknown for equity runouts

policy_variants.hole-chip-ev: call/fold uses true multiway equity versus actual live hands and current contestable-pot odds; aggressive value sizing by equity and stack/blind depth
policy_variants.hole-leader-aware: same oracle information and equity, but when currently sole chip leader requires at least 70% equity (and 8 points above pot odds) to call a large commitment of at least 25% of hand-start stack
policy_variants.saved-reference: canonical saved policy, paired on identical sampled opponents, seat, and deal

protocol.pool_construction: five fixed anchors plus 16 new_random genomes; each job sampled 7 opponents using evolution._build_tournament_job
